note: Generated by scripts/docs/discover-reproducers.mjs: one reproducer per refusal code and verifier family. Entries with derivation "authored", and the unreachable list, are written by hand and kept.

ACCEPTANCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH.note: The settlement names another acceptance plan digest.

ACCOUNT_INVALID.note: The account is a bare string instead of an object carrying a descriptor.

ANCHOR_INVALID.note: The anchor txid is not 64 lowercase hex characters.

ASSET_OUTPUT_MIXED.note: The taker's own inscription lands on the output that receives the maker's inscription.

BUYER_ASSET_OUTPUT_MISSING.note: The asset output meant for the buyer pays the seller instead.

COUNTERPARTY_NOT_MOVED.note: Every output is the zero-value runestone (a zero-amount rune allocation makes it permitted) and the whole input value is the fee, so Counterparty finds no destination and detaches the attachment.

DATA_OUTPUT_NONSTANDARD.note: The runestone output is 84 bytes, over the 83 byte relay limit.
The runestone output is 84 bytes, over the 83 byte relay limit.

DUST_OUTPUT.note: The recovery pays one sat, below the dust threshold for its script.

EVENTS_MALFORMED.note: The expectation names no transaction id.

FOREIGN_SIGNATURE_INVALID.note: The other party's preserved signature is presented with one byte changed, identically in the manifest and the PSBT.

GIVE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH.note: The intent gives 1 unit of a Counterparty asset, but the committed outpoint holds 2 and Counterparty moves them all.

INPUT_DUPLICATED.note: The first seller input is spent twice.

INPUT_ORDER_CHANGED.note: The signed transaction swaps the first two inputs.

INPUT_SET_CHANGED.note: The signed transaction drops the last input the manifest presented.
The signed transaction drops the last planned input.

LEDGER_EVENT_INVALID.note: The ledger recorded the move with status invalid.

LEDGER_EVENT_MISSING.note: The ledger holds no event for the expected move.

LEDGER_EVENT_UNEXPECTED.note: The ledger moved a different quantity than the plan expected.

LOCKTIME_UNDETERMINED.note: A PSBT v2 whose first input requires a time locktime and second a height locktime.

MAKER_OUTPOINT_REASSIGNED.note: The input spending the maker commitment is attributed to the taker.

MALFORMED_RUNE_EXPECTATION.note: The expected allocation is a string, not a list.

MALFORMED_SIGNED_RESULT.note: The settlement is a list, not a signed settlement object.

OUTPUT_SET_CHANGED.note: The signed transaction adds an output the plan does not have.

PARTY_SCRIPTS_OVERLAP.note: The seller payment script is the buyer receive script.

POLICY_WITNESS_INVALID.note: The offer input witness has one element instead of four.

PREVIOUS_DIGEST_FORBIDDEN.note: A version 1 manifest names a previous manifest.

RECOVERY_WITNESS_INVALID.note: The recovery witness has two elements instead of three.

RUNE_INPUT_UNPROVEN.note: Input 0 was not examined by the rune index.

RUNE_MINT_UNRESOLVED.note: The runestone also mints the rune the inputs carry, and no mint result is supplied.

SELLER_OUTPUT_MISSING.note: The transaction ends after the asset outputs, with no seller payment.

SIGNATURE_INVALID.note: Input 0 carries a signature over other data.

SIGNATURE_UNVERIFIABLE.note: Input 0 of the manifest is a P2WSH output, a script this verifier does not execute.
Input 0 of the plan is a P2WSH output, a script this verifier does not execute.
A taker input is a P2WSH output, a script this verifier does not execute.

TRANSACTION_CHANGED.note: The signed settlement pays one sat less on its last output.

VALUE_CHANGED.note: The signed transaction pays one sat more on output 0.
The signed transaction pays one sat more on output 0.

unreachable.PSBT_MALFORMED|bitcoin-tx: Never returned as a verdict: parsePsbt reports PSBT_MALFORMED to its only caller, offline-signing.js compareSignedResultToManifest, which returns MALFORMED_SIGNED_RESULT with the parse reason instead.
unreachable.TX_MALFORMED|bitcoin-tx: Never returned as a verdict: parseTransaction reports TX_MALFORMED to its callers, and every caller (offers.js checkAcceptance and verifyOfferRecovery, safeops.js verifySafeOpsSignedResult, swaps.js verifySwapSignedTransaction, offline-signing.js compareSignedResultToManifest) returns its own code (TRANSACTION_INVALID or MALFORMED_SIGNED_RESULT) with the parse reason instead.
